name: ZPM_PARTNER_MULTIVAL_LOVS_
description: A generic intersection table that defines values selected for all profile fields that allow multiple values to be selected from simple LOVs that are not justified as entities in their own right.

columns.name: PARTNER_MULTIVAL_LOV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of a specific LOV code selected for a specific multi-value field in the partner profile.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the partner to which this LOV value belongs.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: An LOV code defining the category to which the LOV value belongs.  This value indicates which profile field to which the value belongs.

columns.name: LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: The value from a multi-value LOV category which applies to the profile.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
